questions.prompt: Which statement gives the core rule for “IoT architecture”?
options: Devices measure, communication transports data, and services consume it.
HTTP is request/response; MQTT is pub/sub.
QoS controls delivery guarantees and retransmission behavior.
Protocol QoS alone does not guarantee exactly-once business processing.
questions.answer: Devices measure, communication transports data, and services consume it.
questions.explanation:
Devices measure, communication transports data, and services consume it.
Why: A typical system has devices, a network, gateways, and services/apps. Define identity, data formats, failure behavior, and update ownership at each boundary.

questions.prompt: When applying “IoT architecture” in a project, which action is recommended?
options: HTTP is request/response; MQTT is pub/sub.
A gateway is not mandatory in every deployment; choose architecture for the actual network.
Protocol QoS alone does not guarantee exactly-once business processing.
Separate command topics from telemetry and restrict who may publish commands.
questions.answer: A gateway is not mandatory in every deployment; choose architecture for the actual network.
